hero_desc: InventoAI is the only platform that builds your e-commerce store in minutes and acts as your smart AI Advisor to predict demand, alert you on low stock, and automatically negotiate with suppliers.
pipeline_step_1_sub: Describe your business and AI creates your store instantly.
pipeline_step_2_sub: AI Advisor predicts demand and alerts you on low stock.
pipeline_step_3_sub: AI drafts emails to suppliers and ranks the best offers.
pipeline_step_4_sub: A built-in chatbot assists your shoppers 24/7.
caps_1_desc: Simply answer a few questions about your business, and we generate a fully functional, beautifully designed e-commerce store for you.
caps_2_desc: Stop guessing. Your AI Advisor analyzes historical sales and trends to tell you exactly when to restock and how much to order.
caps_3_desc: Save hours of manual work. Invento automatically drafts purchase requests and summarizes incoming supplier offers for your approval.
caps_4_desc: Automatically create smart categories and attributes for your products, making it easier for customers to find what they want.
cta_desc: Join the entrepreneurs using AI to launch stores and automate inventory.
